transcript: The only way to truly heal your trauma and calm your nervous system is to understand one simple truth. You cannot heal trauma by thinking about it. Trauma does not live in the mind. It lives quietly inside the body. When the body carries old fear, it begins to believe the world is always dangerous. The breath becomes shallow, the shoulders tighten, trust slowly disappears. So healing does not begin in the mind. Healing begins in the body. Start with small things. Take a slow walk and feel the ground beneath your feet. Stretch your body and release the tension in your shoulders. Take a deep breath and allow your chest to rise and fall. Each small moment like this sends a quiet message to your nervous system. I am safe now. And when the body begins to feel safe, the mind slowly follows. Trauma does not disappear through force. It fades through gentle repetition. If you would like gentle guidance to begin this process, I created a 30-day healing journey with simple daily practices to help you reconnect with your body and restore inner calm. You can find it in the link on my profile.
